notes: Explore idea: Heckman sample selection (two-step with Heckman-Greene SEs + full ML with conventional/robust/clustered errors) as a research-algorithm tool; 0 of ~1,405 venture READMEs mentioned Heckman or sample selection. Reference: statsmodels 0.15 / scipy 1.18 (closed forms within 1e-12; ML estimates within 1.2e-8; ML SEs within 1e-5, which is the reference's numerical-Hessian accuracy). Coverage (1,000 draws, n=1,000): with exclusions both corrections cover ~95% vs 57% for OLS. Without exclusions, ML covers 79% around a biased centre (0.074 vs 0.085) and the two-step interval is 10x wider; peak-check.mjs shows the engine's optimum beat logL at the truth in 60/60 draws, so this is a flat likelihood, not the optimiser. No separate agent doc in docs/reports: the venture README and eval/README carry what the next run needs.
